coverage.method: Sitemap/navigation discovery, page-family HTML/CSS inspection, selected browser screenshots and runtime probes where permitted.
coverage.viewports: 1440px desktop and 390px mobile; not every source page was rendered.
coverage.limits: Public page families sampled, not every article, locale, private app or interaction state. Source-only theme/motion declarations are not runtime verification.

color.palette_type: Flat candy accents on warm cream and white panels, with near-black ink.

primary.role: brand yellow (--primary-400 = brutal-yellow): logo tiles, highlight blocks, icon chips

secondary.role: ink: text, 2px borders, and all offset shadows (near-black with warm cast)

accent.role: brutal-pink (--accent-400): primary CTA fill ('Get started'), key highlights

neutral.usage: Cream #fffaef page ground, white cards and chat panels, yellow navigation; muted black/45 mono labels.

surface.elevated: #ffffff (elevation via hard offset shadow, not tint)

color.contrast_strategy: maximum: pure black ink and 2px black borders on white/candy fills; every accent used at full flat saturation, never as a tint gradient. Supporting accents: cyan #27ccf3, lime #a9d877, orange #f8a16f, red #f97264, lavender #bbafe6. Dark-mode token set exists (layer-page oklch 14.5%)

typography.fonts: Space Grotesk for marketing and blog; Space Mono for metadata, labels and chat timestamps.
typography.marketing: Home h1 60/75, weight 700; 390px h1 36/45. Main section h2 36/40, weight 700.
typography.editorial: Blog index h1 54/56; post-card h2 26/32, weight 700.
typography.body: 16/24, weight 400. Overlines 11/16.5 Space Mono, weight 700, tracking +0.55px.

spacing.content_density: comfortable — brutalist elements are chunky but sections breathe
spacing.section_rhythm: Generous cream section bands; left-aligned hero copy and centered section introductions with mono eyebrows.

layout.frame: Home content around 1152px; desktop hero is a left text column + right chat demo, not centered single-column copy.
layout.navigation: Black launch strip above a full-width yellow navigation bar with 2px bottom rule; square language selector and pink CTA.
layout.mobile: 390px: heading 36/45, left aligned; text/CTAs then full-width chat demo. Language selector and square menu button remain; floating stickers reduce.
layout.editorial: Blog index ~1024px; category filter buttons above stacked horizontal image/text cards. Events and legal pages use the same cream/ink shell.

border_radius.large: 0 (token scale sm 4px / md 6px / lg 8px exists but marketing chrome stays square)
border_radius.pill: not used; avatars are square tiles

shape.border_usage: bold 2px solid black borders on everything interactive: buttons, cards, avatar tiles, badges, chat window
shape.divider_style: 2px black rules; sections otherwise separated by whitespace

elevation.shadow_style: hard offset, zero blur — the neo-brutalist paper-cutout stack
elevation.depth_cues: offset shadows + physical press: active state translates +1px/+1px and shrinks shadow to 1px 1px 0, as if pushing the element into the page; hover lifts -1px

iconography.style: small outlined icons at 1.5–2px stroke inside square colored chips with 2px black borders
iconography.preferred_set: in-house/lucide-style strokes; icons sit on brutal-yellow/cyan tiles

motion.easing: ease-in-out for ambient float; snappy linear-ish 100ms for interaction
motion.entrance_pattern: elements mostly render static; ambient float (translateY 0→-6px→0, 4s/6s infinite) on stickers
motion.philosophy: toy-like physicality: hover lifts and grows shadow, click physically depresses; decorative stickers bob and stay rotated (rotate-3/6/12)

components.button_style: square, 2px black border, flat candy fill (pink CTA, white secondary), bold Space Grotesk label, hard shadow; hover -1px lift, active +1px press with shadow collapse
components.card_style: white square cards with 2px black border and 4px offset shadow; icon chip top-left on colored tile
components.navigation_pattern: simple top bar with mono language switcher; links plain bold text
components.list_style: chat-message lists inside a faux Slack-like channel window with square avatar tiles
components.component_notes: Signature component is the hero chat window: an 'engineering #42' channel where human and agent avatars (square, 2px border, on cyan/yellow tiles) exchange timestamped messages. Badges are square mono-font chips. Trusted-logos strip runs as an infinite marquee.

design_style.mood: Playful neo-brutalist workspace: cream paper, candy accents, square pixel avatars and physical buttons.
design_style.composition: Split hero and live channel conversation, followed by strong bordered feature/proof blocks. Yellow navigation anchors every page; blog uses spacious horizontal cards.
design_style.imagery: Chat simulations, pixel avatar tiles, personal photos and diagram-style editorial covers. Covers can contain fine grids even though page surfaces stay flat.
design_style.interaction: Hard shadows and short lift/press feedback; rotated floating stickers add toy-like movement.

visual_effects.technology: No canvas observed on homepage or blog; DOM/CSS carries the effect.
visual_effects.physical_buttons: 2px ink border, 2/4/6px hard offset shadow; hover -1px lift, press +1px translation and shadow collapse to 1px. Source transitions ~100ms.
visual_effects.ambient: float loops observed at 4s and 6s with staggered delays; trusted-logo-marquee 34s linear infinite. Chat channel/content changes while the frame remains stable.
visual_effects.scope: No GPU hero observed; reduced-motion behavior and private app dialogs were not exercised.

page_families./: Split headline/chat demo, yellow navigation, cream background and pixel stickers.
page_families./resources/blog/: 54px index title, square category filters, stacked horizontal cards with diagram covers and author metadata.
page_families./events/: Community event listing in the shared brutalist shell.
page_families./terms/; /privacy/: Long-form legal typography, not a feature-card composition.
